mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. Please be aware that the air quality index is currently at a moderate level of 55.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term roadmap for our city's development, focusing on housing, transportation, and sustainability. Additionally, residents can review all recent engineering reports through the official city website.

There is plenty to do around town, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol, the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call for service, on October 3, local officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man after recovering a stolen firearm from his vehicle during a stop for expired registration.
You can treat yourself to today's delicious flavor of the day, OREO Cookie Overload. The Verona Culver's is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
